dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you, cutie. I knew we'd cross paths again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking at, Lisa?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, just these painted utensils in this shop, aren't they exquisite? I'm thinking about buying some to take back for decoration.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: And those plates... if we serve tea on them, Jean wouldn't be able to resist, even in the middle of work.

choices.text: I don't think those are for sale.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh, not for sale? Honestly, why put it in the shop if you don't intend to sell it?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: How disappointing! Ah, they're so beautiful, too...

choices.text: I think those are only for display.
